articles.title: Two Women Arrested After Three-Year-Old Boy Falls from Window in Rochdale
articles.excerpt: Two women, aged 19 and 20, have been arrested on suspicion of causing serious injury to a child after a three-year-old boy fell from a window in Rochdale and remains in critical condition.
articles.content_html:
BREAKING NEWS — LIVE

Live updates, newest first.

00:59, 24 August 2026

Two women, aged 19 and 20, have been arrested on suspicion of causing serious injury to a child after a three-year-old boy fell from a window in Rochdale and remains in critical condition.

18:27, 23 August 2026

A three-year-old boy is in critical condition after falling from a first-floor window in Spotland Tops, Rochdale. Two women, aged 19 and 20, have been arrested on suspicion of causing serious injury to a child.

Two women have been arrested following a serious incident involving a three-year-old boy who fell from a window in Rochdale. The incident occurred on Saturday, August 22, at a property located in Spotland Tops, in the Cutgate area of the town. Emergency services were called to the scene shortly after 4.15pm, responding to reports of concern for the welfare of a child.

Upon arrival, police and paramedics found the boy had sustained critical injuries from the fall. An air ambulance was also deployed to assist in transporting the child to hospital, where he remains in a critical condition. Greater Manchester Police (GMP) confirmed that the boy fell from a first-floor window of the property.

On Sunday, August 23, GMP announced the arrest of two women, aged 19 and 20, at a property in Blackburn. They were taken into custody on suspicion of causing serious injury to a child. The police have stated that inquiries into the full circumstances surrounding the incident are ongoing.

This incident has raised significant concern within the local community, and further updates from GMP are expected as the investigation progresses. Anyone with information related to the incident is encouraged to come forward to assist the police.

articles.title: Significant police presence at Cutgate Precinct
articles.excerpt: A significant police presence has been reported at Cutgate Precinct this evening. Details are still emerging and this story will be updated.
articles.content_html:
A significant police presence has been reported at Cutgate Precinct this evening.

Multiple officers were seen in the area of the precinct outside Miami Crispy, and residents nearby have reported ongoing police activity.

The nature of the incident has not yet been confirmed, and Greater Manchester Police has not released a statement at the time of publication.

This is a developing story and will be updated as soon as verified information becomes available. If you were in the area and have information, you can contact Greater Manchester Police on 101, or 999 in an emergency.
